But GR3 sets the record size of every FD/SD record, and in 2002 that includes an FD with the FORMAT clause (13.16.22), a required 2002 element with no optional licence (3.1.1; same finding as q-28 for OPEN); GR2 of this very clause names the FORMAT clause as affecting only the physical size, so GR3's logical-record size explicitly governs FORMAT files. 2023 makes FORMAT optional (A.4.8) and the compiler declines it, so the 2023 row's witnesses (pb1277_record_size_in_bytes) contain no FORMAT file. Probe rec_format.cob (FD FF FORMAT CHARACTER DATA RECORD CONTAINS 12, 01 with PIC 99 + ODO 1 TO 10): refused COBOL1705 at --std 2002 (citing §2023 A.4.8); the same FD without FORMAT (rec_noformat.cob) gives LEN=12 OPEN=00. needs: a 2002 witness for a FORMAT-file record size once FORMAT is supported at --std 2002.
